reference_boundary: External harness and loop engineering repositories are absorbed as contracts, vocabulary, evidence fields and gate shapes only. This manifest does not clone, install, import, execute, start daemons, register hooks, enable MCP servers or turn on external runtimes.

fixtures.notes: Clean-room synthetic fixture; validates contract fields without running external benchmark, container, daemon, service or scheduler.

quality_gates: task execution is reproducible from pinned source, environment and runner command
scorer is declared before execution and does not depend on hidden manual judgement
failure replay stores enough evidence to re-run the failing case
resource budget is explicit before long-running or containerized evaluation
must_not: run arbitrary benchmark containers by default
score without pinned source revision
claim pass without artifact evidence

quality_gates: eval suite declares positive and negative cases before promotion
non-LLM assertions are preferred when deterministic checks exist
LLM judge policy records model, prompt version, threshold and retry budget
red-team scope is explicit for security or safety-sensitive routing
must_not: use only happy-path eval cases
hide flaky failures under aggregate pass rate
treat judge output as source of truth without sampled review

quality_gates: task registry separates task definition from backend adapter
dataset and prompt versions are pinned for comparisons
result schema is stable enough for trend comparison
must_not: mix model comparison with unpinned prompt changes
compare runs without backend and dataset metadata

quality_gates: terminal task execution claims require a declared test script and oracle before run
sandbox backend, timeout, resource budget and cleanup policy are explicit
stdout, stderr and exit code are captured as replay evidence
dataset version is pinned for comparison across agents or models
must_not: run terminal benchmarks on unrestricted host shell
execute unreviewed setup commands without owner approval
claim pass without oracle and exit code evidence

quality_gates: durable execution claims include replayable state history and deterministic replay policy
external side effects are isolated behind activity boundaries
retry, timeout and cancellation policies are declared before execution
idempotency evidence is present for repeated or resumed actions
must_not: claim durability from narrative state only
retry side effects without idempotency key
resume without recovery owner and failure replay evidence

quality_gates: loop state is explicit and serializable before durable resume is claimed
retry and stop conditions are declared before execution
human gate records input, decision and resume point
failure replay names the checkpoint and observation needed to reproduce the branch
must_not: use hidden conversational state as the only loop state
retry without budget
resume without checkpoint evidence

quality_gates: workspace boundary distinguishes read, write and destructive actions
each loop action captures observation and resulting artifact path
test command and rollback path are known before patch application
approval boundary is explicit for network, privileged and destructive actions
must_not: execute generated code without sandbox policy
mutate workspace without observation capture
merge patch artifacts without verification command

quality_gates: graph nodes declare typed input and output schemas before execution
human approval requests record requested action, risk and allowed decisions
resume points and state storage policy are available before HITL suspension
validation failures have an explicit repair or handoff policy
must_not: resume a human-gated flow without a recorded decision
hide schema validation failures in free-form notes
store graph state without a reviewed storage policy

quality_gates: parallel branches declare join policy before execution
edge conditions are inspectable and testable
timeouts have failure handling and handoff evidence
must_not: encode routing only in prose when a manifest contract is available
fan out without join ownership

quality_gates: pipeline claims declare local and CI parity before promotion
artifact inputs and outputs are named before execution
trace export, archive and rollback policies are present before scheduled automation
container or runtime spec requires owner approval before any execution
must_not: require a hosted service for baseline ADK verification
mutate production resources from report-only pipeline definitions
run background jobs without owner, schedule and stop policy

quality_gates: coding loop captures repo map or equivalent codebase context before edit
patch scope, lint command, test command and rollback path are known before repair
failed lint or test output is recorded as the next repair observation
completion requires git diff review and command evidence
must_not: auto-commit or merge without owner policy
repair indefinitely without attempt budget
claim completion without lint or test evidence when such commands exist

quality_gates: sandbox policy is reviewed before enabling code execution tools
deny paths and secret policy are explicit
logs are redacted before long-term storage
must_not: default-enable code execution from external agent runtimes
store secrets in traces
open network access without owner approval

quality_gates: artifact evidence links producer step, consumer step and source input
version or digest is recorded before artifact reuse
quality check, retention policy and supersedes relation are explicit
evidence path exists before artifact-backed completion claims
must_not: store unversioned evidence as reusable artifact
overwrite artifacts without supersedes linkage
hide generated artifacts outside report or evidence paths

quality_gates: eval evidence links trace, dataset, prompt version and score schema
metric thresholds and regression links are declared before promotion
production feedback sources are redacted and classified before storage
evidence bundle path exists for completion and routing claims
must_not: compare eval runs without dataset and prompt version
store raw production traces without redaction policy
promote an agent loop from aggregate score alone

quality_gates: trace evidence links decisions, tool calls, handoffs and guardrail outcomes
redaction policy is declared before storing traces
trace spans can be mapped back to evaluation failures
must_not: store raw secrets or private user data in traces
claim observability from console logs only

quality_gates: guardrail trigger condition is testable through positive and negative cases
handoff target and user-visible effect are explicit
override policy requires evidence and owner review
must_not: silently suppress tool failures
handoff ownership without audit evidence
